$comment: awesome-kit depends on plugins-kit:skills-kit for the plugin-ecosystem audit framework and skills_kit_lib. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED: dispatch.py needs bootstrap_lib.codex for launcher resolution and the cmd-metacharacter refusal, and the orchestrate renderer parses routing rows with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration. llm_kit (the llm-kit plugin's library) has no install edge: the renderer DEGRADES without it (rows list only the Claude core ids, disclosed in the render) and dispatch.py REFUSES without it (--model is resolved through its registry); both probe for llm-kit >= 0.1.9 (llm_kit.dispatch.declaration.describe, llm_kit.registry.models.discover_model_entries, llm_kit.dispatch.seats.discover_seats, llm_kit.adapters.harness_adapters) and diagnose absent and too-old apart. No legacy library is consulted in its place. Auto-install skills-kit when missing. requires_bootstrap is set from the newest bootstrap call this plugin makes: orchestration_guidance.py calls bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse_entries ({id, effort} routing entries), first shipped in bootstrap 0.150.0 (the plugin-ecosystem skill's BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON launch needs 0.120.0, and dispatch.py's bootstrap_lib.codex.build_codex_exec_argv 0.79.0).
